content:
Marco (Sales): Passing Xylo Health over to CS. Signed POC, target go-live in ~3 weeks. Key risks: Okta SSO, reserved capacity estimate may be low for peak, procurement asking about annual discount (renewal in 11 months). They may evaluate private deploy later.

Aisha (CS): Thanks Marco — taking lead. Can @Evan own SSO test + provisioning? Also we need billing contact and PO.

Evan (Infra Eng): I can own the SSO connector + provisioning. Need their Okta metadata and a test account. Any preferred time for the integration window?

Marco (Sales): Sending metadata to the thread now and emailing them. Link: https://files.redwood/xylo/okta-metadata (shared).

Rina (Support): I'll open a ticket to track provisioning + runbook and monitor post-provisioning. Creating ticket now.

ticket-bot: Ticket INC-78912 created (owners: CS Aisha, Eng Evan, Sales Marco). Priority: P2. https://tickets.redwood/INC-78912

Aisha (CS): Action items and success criteria: 1) Evan: SSO test by Mon 10am PT; 2) Rina: provisioning checklist + runbook by Wed COB; 3) Marco: confirm billing contact + PO # by Tue noon. Success metrics to capture in enablement: API latency target <300ms for 90% of calls, and 99.9% availability on dedicated pool. I'll schedule enablement session Fri.

Evan (Infra Eng): If metadata is complete I can do connector + verify auth flows by Mon EOD. Need confirmation on reserved GPU pool size (sales estimate was 2xV100 equiv).

Marco (Sales): Sales estimate: 2 x V100 equivalent reserved. I'll confirm with procurement and ping billing. Also they asked about quantized model options for cost savings — flagging Optimize team.

Aisha (CS): Noted on quantization. Rina — please include escalation path (oncall + eng rotation) in the runbook. We'll capture feedback during the enablement call and add to the onboarding eval.

Rina (Support): Adding runbook now. Quick provisioning checklist snippet:

```
- Create customer org in prod
- Provision dedicated GPU pool: 2xV100 (confirm size)
- SSO test: exchange metadata, create test user, verify SAML flows
- Create API key scoped for dev/test
- Schedule enablement demo (Fri 2pm PT)
- Post-provision smoke tests and alerting configured
```

I'll attach this to INC-78912 and set reminders.

Evan (Infra Eng): FYI: if they want quantized models we'll need to validate model artifacts and run quick perf/regression checks. I'll add that eval step to the ticket.

Marco (Sales): Billing contact confirmed: billing@xylo.health. PO # expected tomorrow morning. I emailed them the metadata and the basic provisioning ETA.

Aisha (CS): Owners & deadlines summary: Evan — SSO + eval by Mon EOD; Rina — runbook + monitoring by Wed COB; Marco — billing + reserved capacity confirm by Tue noon. Follow-up sync Thurs 11am PT if any blocker remains. Tagging @here for visibility :eyes:

(End of thread)
